relationships.subject: Betulinic acid analog 8
relationships.evidence_quote: When CaV2.2 channels were expressed in this cellular milieu, its activity was robustly reduced by analog 8

relationships.subject: Betulinic acid analog 8
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, the results from these heterologous cells show that compound 8 modulates calcium current through a specific block of CaV2.2 and CaV3.2 channels.

relationships.subject: Betulinic acid analog 8
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal administration of analog 8 (2 µg in 5 µl) significantly increased paw withdrawal thresholds (PWTs)

key_findings: Betulinic acid analog 8 inhibits N-type (Cav2.2) and T-type (Cav3.2) channels and reduces depolarization-evoked calcium influx in rat DRG neurons.
Intrathecal analog 8 is antinociceptive in the rat spared nerve injury and formalin models.
